answer: Stop sybils with a vault, a glacier, and quartz. Each identity locks its bond in a vault that thaws only as fast as a glacier: one layer per epoch, sequential and memory-hard, so N clones each wait out the full thaw alone. Influence is carved in quartz: every identity must hold one facet cut by an unrelated peer, and facets interlock into a lattice. Facets from one funder share a single lattice fault, so one audit that finds the fault shatters the whole lattice and burns every bond at once. One honest agent risks one vault; a clone factory pays N vault bonds for one fault.
